problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis in the direction of increasing $x$ where $x>0.$ When the displacement of $P$ from the origin $O$ is $x\,m,$ its velocity is $v\,m/s,$ the magnitude of its acceleration is ${2}^{2-x}\operatorname{ln}⁡2\,{m/s}^{2}$ and the acceleration is directed toward $O.$ If $P$ has a displacement of $1\,m$ when its velocity is $4\,m/s,$ find $v$ in terms of $x.$

activity_context.topic_title: Velocity and Acceleration as Functions of Displacement
